text:
How you slip between my hands! How you glide away, my age! What silent steps, cold death, making all equal!


Fierce, you scale youth's weak earthen wall; my heart awaits the final day's flight without seeing wings.


O mortal condition, harsh fate! I cannot wish to live tomorrow without procuring death!


Each instant is a new execution warning how fragile, wretched, vain life is.

translation.title: How You Slip Away between My Hands!...
